From 7b2d039da622daa9ba259ac6f38701d542b237c3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Anthony Krowiak <akrowiak@linux.ibm.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2023 11:44:20 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] s390/vfio-ap: unpin pages on gisc registration failure

In the vfio_ap_irq_enable function, after the page containing the
notification indicator byte (NIB) is pinned, the function attempts
to register the guest ISC. If registration fails, the function sets the
status response code and returns without unpinning the page containing
the NIB. In order to avoid a memory leak, the NIB should be unpinned before
returning from the vfio_ap_irq_enable function.

Co-developed-by: Janosch Frank <frankja@linux.ibm.com>
Signed-off-by: Janosch Frank <frankja@linux.ibm.com>
Signed-off-by: Anthony Krowiak <akrowiak@linux.ibm.com>
Reviewed-by: Matthew Rosato <mjrosato@linux.ibm.com>
Fixes: 783f0a3ccd79 ("s390/vfio-ap: add s390dbf logging to the vfio_ap_irq_enable function")
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20231109164427.460493-2-akrowiak@linux.ibm.com
Signed-off-by: Alexander Gordeev <agordeev@linux.ibm.com>

diff --git a/drivers/s390/crypto/vfio_ap_ops.c b/drivers/s390/crypto/vfio_ap_ops.c
index 4db538a55192..9cb28978c186 100644
--- a/drivers/s390/crypto/vfio_ap_ops.c
+++ b/drivers/s390/crypto/vfio_ap_ops.c
@@ -457,6 +457,7 @@ static struct ap_queue_status vfio_ap_irq_enable(struct vfio_ap_queue *q,
 		VFIO_AP_DBF_WARN("%s: gisc registration failed: nisc=%d, isc=%d, apqn=%#04x\n",
 				 __func__, nisc, isc, q->apqn);
 
+		vfio_unpin_pages(&q->matrix_mdev->vdev, nib, 1);
 		status.response_code = AP_RESPONSE_INVALID_GISA;
 		return status;
 	}
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/s390/crypto/vfio_ap_ops.c`**
   - A new line was added in the `vfio_ap_irq_enable` function to unpin the page containing the notification indicator byte (NIB) if the registration of the guest ISC fails. This line is placed before the function returns, ensuring that the page is unpinned to prevent a memory leak.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `vfio_ap_ops.c` addresses a specific issue where the NIB page was not being unpinned upon a failure in ISC registration. By adding the unpinning operation, the patch ensures that resources are properly managed, thus preventing memory leaks. This change is directly related to the bug fix described in the patch, which aims to improve the robustness of the `vfio_ap_irq_enable` function.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
ret = vfio_pin_pages(&q->matrix_mdev->vdev, nib, 1, IOMMU_READ | IOMMU_WRITE, &h_page);
nisc = kvm_s390_gisc_register(kvm, isc);
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the `vfio_ap_irq_enable` function pins a page containing the notification indicator byte (NIB) but does not unpin it if the registration of the guest ISC fails. This oversight leads to a memory leak, as the pinned page remains allocated without being released.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
vfio_unpin_pages(&q->matrix_mdev->vdev, nib, 1);
```
Reason:
The patch adds a call to `vfio_unpin_pages` right after the ISC registration failure, ensuring that the pinned page is unpinned before returning from the function. This prevents the memory leak by releasing the allocated page when the registration fails.
